# GitHub Signals

> An independent publication discovering useful open-source projects and developer tools.

Canonical website: https://githubsignals.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/githubsignals/

- [Project discoveries](https://githubsignals.com/projects): editorial articles with direct repository links and original Instagram permalinks.
- [Tools and offers](https://githubsignals.com/tools): clearly disclosed recommendations; offers publish only with confirmed agreements.
- [Partnerships](https://githubsignals.com/partners): sponsorship enquiries.
- [Editorial and affiliate policy](https://githubsignals.com/disclosure)
- [Privacy](https://githubsignals.com/privacy)

The newsletter is weekly and requires confirmation. The publication is independent of GitHub, Inc.
